title: Nordson Corporation Announces Earnings Release and Webcast for First Quarter Fiscal Year 2026
summary: Nordson Corporation (Nasdaq: NDSN) today announced it will release first quarter fiscal year 2026 earnings on February 18, 2026, after the close of the market. Nordson will host its quarterly webcast on: Date: Thursday, February 19, 2026 Time: 8:30 AM ET Link to listen: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/367186026 Investors who are interested in listening to the webcast, but are not able to participate during the scheduled time, can access the replay by visiting Nordson's investor website . Nordson Corporation is an innovative precision technology company that leverages a scalable growth framework through an entrepreneurial, division-led organization to deliver top tier growth with leading margins and returns. The Company’s direct sales model and applications expertise serves global customers through a wide variety of critical applications.
